title: Evacuees from Oleshky promptly issued documents and bank cards – Lubinets
summary: Residents evacuated from Oleshky were promptly issued documents and bank cards while staying at the Kyiv Regional Hospital. They are already receiving assistance from the Ukrainian government and international partners.

title: Russia's war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 1,710 over past day
summary: The total combat losses of Russian forces in the war against Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to November 14, 2026, have reached approximately 1,620,630 personnel, including 1,710 troops killed or wounded over the past 24 hours.

title: Trump to meet with Xi and Putin next Thursday – New York Post
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump will hold a trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian leader Vladimir Putin on November 19 in Shenzhen, China, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit.

title: Evacuees from Oleshky receive medical and social assistance in Zakarpattia region
summary: Residents evacuated from the temporarily occupied city of Oleshky in the Kherson region continue to arrive in the Zakarpattia region, where they are receiving medical, social and psychological assistance.

title: Europe must learn modern warfare from Ukraine – ARX Robotics CEO
summary: European armies must learn from Ukraine's experience in modern warfare and accelerate the adoption of new military technologies to avoid falling behind Russia in critical areas.

title: Zelensky holds meeting with mayors on winter preparations, says talks will be regular
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has discussed preparations by communities across Ukraine for the winter period amid continued Russian attacks with mayors from different parts of the country.

title: Schiphol Airport donates 29 passenger buses to Ukraine
summary: The Netherlands' largest airport, Schiphol, has donated 29 passenger buses to Ukraine. The buses were previously used to transport passengers from aircraft to the terminal.

title: Ukraine has lost 630 locomotives to Russian attacks, nearly 400 of them this year – Kalashnyk
summary: Ukraine has lost 630 locomotives as a result of Russian attacks since the start of the full-scale invasion, with nearly 400 of those losses occurring this year.

title: Russia designates Ukraine's Yellow Ribbon resistance movement ‘extremist organization’
summary: Russia has designated the Yellow Ribbon Ukrainian resistance movement an “extremist organization” and banned its activities on Russian territory.

title: SSU foils Russian plot to strike Kyiv, arrests suspected agent spying on military positions
summary: The Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) has detained a man in Kyiv suspected of helping guide Russian missile and drone attacks and prepare new strikes against Ukrainian Defense Forces units and civilian facilities in the capital.

title: National Guard drones hit over 316,000 enemy targets since Russia’s full-scale invasion – Pivnenko
summary: Since the start of Russia’s full-scale invasion, Ukrainian National Guard unmanned systems crews have hit more than 316,000 enemy targets, nearly 150,000 of which have been destroyed.

title: Remains of Russian drone recovered from Dnipro River in Kyiv
summary: Rescuers have recovered the remains of an enemy drone from the Dnipro River in Kyiv's Obolonskyi district. The debris fell into the river during a Russian attack on November 11.

title: Russians launch missile strike on Pavlohrad, leaving three injured
summary: Russian forces launched a missile strike on Pavlohrad during the afternoon of November 14. The attack damaged residential infrastructure and injured three people.

title: Russian drones attack Naftogaz facility in Poltava region
summary: Russian drones attacked one of the Naftogaz Group's facilities in the Poltava region during the day on November 14, causing a fire.

title: Trump may delay strikes on Iran if Yemen refrains from new provocations – Reuters
summary: US President Donald Trump recently told his senior advisers that he may hold off on strikes against Iran if Tehran or the Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen refrain from further provocations.

title: Bulgaria halts arms and ammunition supplies to Ukraine from its military stockpiles
summary: Bulgaria will not provide Ukraine with any new financial assistance for weapons purchases and is ending the supply of arms and ammunition from its military stockpiles.

title: WTA Finals: Svitolina defeats Sabalenka to reach semifinals
summary: Ukraine’s top-ranked tennis player, Elina Svitolina, has continued her bid for the title at the WTA Finals in the American city of Indian Wells, where the tournament offers a prize pool of $10 million.

title: US Senator calls Russia's demand for NATO troop withdrawal 'preposterous'
summary: US Senate Intelligence Committee Chairman and Republican Senator Tom Cotton has described Russia's demand that NATO withdraw its forces to the alliance's "1997 borders" as absurd, saying that further negotiations with Moscow are currently pointless.

title: Russians strike Zaporizhzhia: Residential building, educational institution damaged, 15 injured
summary: Russian forces struck the Voznesenivskyi district of Zaporizhzhia, injuring four people initially.

title: Debris from Russian drone falls on medical facility grounds in Kyiv's Holosiivskyi district
summary: Debris from a Russian unmanned aerial vehicle fell on the grounds of a medical facility in Kyiv's Holosiivskyi district.

title: Zelensky: Putin personally does not support ceasefire
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that Russian President Vladimir Putin personally does not support establishing a ceasefire.

title: Zelensky on Starshield restrictions in temporarily occupied territories: Ukraine to raise this issue at every level
summary: Starshield speed restrictions of up to 161 km/h remain in place in Ukraine's temporarily occupied territories. This complicates the interception of Russian jet-powered Shahed drones and gives Russia additional opportunities to launch attacks. Ukraine will raise the issue through all relevant channels.

title: SSU drones strike oil facility in Russia’s Samara region
summary:
Long-range drones operated by the Alpha Special Operations Center of the Security Service
of Ukraine (SSU) struck the Samara Linear Production and Dispatch Station near the
settlement of Prosvet in Russia’s Samara region.

title: Russian forces strike Derhachi with drone, leaving three injured
summary:
Russian forces struck the city of Derhachi in the Kharkiv region with a drone, injuring three
people. Four children suffered acute stress reactions.

title: Russia seeks to capture Kostiantynivka under pretext of evacuating civilians – Zelensky
summary: Russia is proposing a "humanitarian operation" in Kostiantynivka under the pretext of protecting civilians, but its aim is to occupy the city and advance toward Kramatorsk and Sloviansk.

title: Zelensky: Russia seeks to revise Europe’s security architecture
summary:
President Volodymyr Zelensky said that Russia is seeking to revise the security architecture,
at least in Europe, and that this is dangerous.

title: Russian forces attack energy facility in Odesa region, nearly 50,000 consumers left without power
summary: Nearly 50,000 consumers in the Odesa region remain without electricity following a Russian strike on an energy facility.

title: Warehouses damaged in Russian drone attack on Kyiv region
summary: A fire broke out in warehouse facilities in the Vyshhorod district following a Russian attack on Saturday.

title: Russian forces attack Hlukhiv in morning drone strike, three injured, including child
summary: Three people, including a nine-year-old boy, were injured in a drone attack on the city of Hlukhiv in the Sumy region early on November 14.

title: Drone attack: Debris falls at two locations in Kyiv's Holosiivskyi district
summary: Debris from a Russian UAV fell at two locations in Kyiv's Holosiivskyi district on Saturday.

title: Democrats urge Musk to preserve records on Starlink operations in Ukraine – media
summary: Democrats on the Senate Foreign Relations Committee have asked SpaceX CEO Elon Musk to "preserve all documents, communications and electronically stored information" related to the company's Starlink and Starshield systems in Ukraine, amid reports that their use by the Ukrainian military has been restricted.

title: One killed, two injured in Russian attacks on Kharkiv region over past day
summary: One person was killed and two civilians injured as seven settlements in the Kharkiv region came under Russian attacks over the past 24 hours.

title: Two killed, five injured in Russian attacks on Kherson region over past day
summary: Russian forces killed two people and injured five others in the Kherson region over the past 24 hours.

title: Three killed, 62 injured in Russian attacks on Zaporizhzhia region over past day
summary: Russian forces launched nearly 884 attacks on the Zaporizhzhia region over the past 24 hours, killing three people, including a child, and injuring 62 others.

title: Widespread emergency power outage reported in Sumy region
summary: A large-scale emergency power outage has affected part of the Sumy region following systematic Russian attacks on energy infrastructure.

title: War update: 273 clashes on front lines over past day, Pokrovsk sector hottest
summary: On November 13, Ukrainian forces engaged in 273 combat clashes with Russian invaders along the front line.

title: Air defenses neutralize 81 of 96 drones launched by Russia against Ukraine since evening
summary: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 81 of the 96 drones launched by Russia against Ukraine since the evening of November 13.
